title: Evals friction checklist — Sept 30 prep (personal scratchpad)
content:
Purpose:
- Quick personal prep ahead of the Optimize / Evals review (weds 10/01). Goal: surface highest-impact regressions, confirm reproducibility, and leave with a short actionable plan (<= 5 tickets).

Meeting context:
- Alert triggered: weekly quality monitoring showed a +6% drop in end-to-end pass rate for the billing prompt set (PS-182) since last rollout. A/B data suggests variant B (prompt+system tweak) underperforms on slot-filling.
- Visible user impact: intermittent hallucination on multi-line address fields (affects ~1.4% of live requests; threshold for page incident is 2.0%).

Pre-meeting quick checks (15–20 min) — what I will run before the call:
1) Sanity queries:
   - Recent aggregated metric snapshot (last 72h):
     * QA_pass_rate (PS-182): SELECT hour, pass_rate FROM metrics.evals WHERE prompt_set='PS-182' ORDER BY hour DESC LIMIT 72;
   - Latency/cost: pull token-level distribution for the variant vs control:
     * quick script: scripts/metrics_pull.sh --prompt-set PS-182 --window 72h --buckets token_length
2) Sample reproduction (local):
   - Run focused harness on the 200-seed failing sample (seeds from alert export):
     python tools/run_local_eval.py --model=redwood-7b-q4 --prompt-set=PS-182 --subset=alert-failures-200 --output=tmp/ps182-repro.json
3) Check config diff between rollout tags (v2026-09-18 -> v2026-09-25):
   - git diff releases/v2026-09-18..releases/v2026-09-25 -- config/prompt-templates/ps-182.yaml
4) Quick glance at logs for hallucination traces (SRE filter):
   - logs query: service:redwood-inference AND tik_mask:PS-182 AND message:"address" AND severity:warning,info (last 7d)

Agenda (30 minutes):
- 0–5m: Context recap (alerts, severity, immediate user-visible impact).
- 5–12m: Repro summary (I share local run + a couple of failing examples).
- 12–20m: Hypothesis triage (why variant B regresses) + decide up to 2 quick experiments.
- 20–28m: Ownership and runbook (who does what in next 48h).
- 28–30m: Escalation decision / rollback criteria.

Hypotheses (ranked):
1) Prompt-template tokenization edge-case: recent newline normalization changed slots -> answers truncated. (high plausibility)
2) Model variant mismatch: fallback routing sent some requests to a quantized variant (7b-q4f) with KV-cache warmer issues. (medium)
3) Post-processing reranker threshold tightened, rejecting correct but less-likely completions. (medium)
4) Dataset drift in PS-182: new customer samples include multi-line addresses with commas; prompt wasn't updated. (low->medium)

Quick experiments (choose 1–2):
- Exp A (fast rollbackable): revert newline normalization for PS-182 in staging and run 1,000 sample harness. Success criteria: pass_rate delta >= +4% vs current. Time: ~2h. Owner: Eliot.
- Exp B (investigative): Enable detailed KV-cache debug (sample 100 requests) on a small pool of nodes to verify cache misses. Time: ~3h to collect logs. Owner: Noah.
- Exp C (post-processing): Temporarily relax reranker threshold by 0.05 and re-run evaluation on failing seeds. If false positives rise >1% -> revert. Owner: Rhea.

Immediate action items (post-meeting) — create these during call:
- (A1) Create single shared ticket JIRA-OPT-xxxx: include sample failures, local reproduction artifacts, metric snapshots, hypothesis list. (Owner: Eliot, due 24h)
- (A2) Kick off Exp A on staging, link logs to ticket. (Owner: Eliot, due 48h)
- (A3) Enable KV-cache debug trace for one replica group; collect 2k requests. (Owner: Noah, due 48h)
- (A4) Run reranker-threshold sensitivity sweep (three points) on alert sample and report precision/recall. (Owner: Rhea, due 72h)
- (A5) Draft rollback note for ops (steps + quick-commands) and share in #platform-incidents. (Owner: Eliot, due 24h)

Rollback / mitigation playbook (ready-to-paste):
- If live fail rate > 2.0% for 60m OR reproducible regressions on >=5% of random sample -> immediate rollback to releases/v2026-09-18 for PS-182.
- Quick revert command:
   1) api rollout set --route=ps-182 --tag=releases/v2026-09-18 --reason="regression-PS182-2026-09-30"
   2) monitor: scripts/wait_for_stable.sh ps-182 10m
   3) post-rollback: postmortem checklist (owner, timeline, customer impact estimate)

Notes-to-self / talking points:
- Keep discussion outcome-oriented: avoid deep model-surgery in this meeting. We want reproducibility + one reversible experiment.
- Pull up 3 small failing examples to show hallucination pattern (short, high-impact).
- If KV-cache looks flaky, escalate to serving-runtime channel & loop in SRE immediately.
- Emphasize cost tradeoff if we relax reranker: show delta on token-cost estimate.

Data & artifacts to attach in ticket:
- tmp/ps182-repro.json (local harness output)
- metric snapshots CSV (hourly_pass_rate_ps182.csv)
- 10 example request/response pairs (anonymized)
- config diff (ps-182) between tags

Follow-ups and checkpoints:
- 24h: ticket created + rollback note posted (owner: Eliot).
- 48h: results from Exp A + KV-cache logs (owners: Eliot, Noah).
- 72h: reranker sensitivity results (Rhea).
- 1 week: decision whether to keep prompt template change, or schedule deeper model variant audit.

Unresolved questions (call to surface):
- Was there any sharded rollout (subset of customers) that would explain limited exposure? check routing policy.
- Any recent infra deploys that coincided with alert window? ask release-eng.

Slack links / refs to drop in meeting:
- #optimize: https://slack.redwood.ai/archives/COPT12345 (drop ticket link when created)
- Ops runbook: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/OPS/Eval-Rollback-Playbook

Final reminder to self: keep notes concise in the ticket; avoid speculative long-form analysis — do quick experiments and surface facts. If we don't reproduce within 6h, escalate to on-call SRE for live tracing.

-- end of scratchpad --
